description.text:
Dynamax Tactics (极巨攻防) was the first enhanced expansion (强化包) of the Sword & Shield series, on sale from 28 June 2023 in six-card packs with two holos. From this set on, a box of enhanced expansion packs held 20 packs. Eldegoss V is on its cover.

It brought Dragapult V and Dragapult VMAX, Vikavolt V, the type-boosting Special Energy cards Heat Fire Energy, Speed Lightning Energy and Horror Psychic Energy, and Capture Energy. It also brought a group of four Pokémon with the attack Mad Party (疯狂派对), which does more damage for each Mad Party Pokémon in the discard pile: Polteageist, Galarian Mr. Rime, Dedenne and Diggersby. Its main cards are numbered out of 55; shiny, full-art, shiny full-art, rainbow and gold cards run to 96.
